description: Read a business's CallRail call-tracking setup. action=status returns the connected CallRail account, which CallRail companies feed which business, every company the saved key can see (with its company_id), and the businesses you can link them to. action=list_trackers (with link_id from status) returns that company's tracking numbers, where each one rings now, and whether it already rings a KaiCalls line. If nothing is connected yet, ask the person for their CallRail API key and use manage_callrail connect.
name: get_callrail
title: Read CallRail setup
